claims.claim: Declares index.ts as the package's only Pi extension surface and requires Node.js 22.19 or newer.
Registers commands for fast mode and OpenAI subscription usage.
Registers the settings command, hosted image surfaces, and pet command controller from the single extension entry point.
Fast mode adds service_tier only when active and the current model matches configured support.
Uses the before_provider_request hook to inject fast-mode payload changes rather than registering a provider.
Loads project and global JSON configuration, gives project values precedence, fills defaults, and clamps selected intervals and pet size.
Limits image input paths to readable files inside the current workspace and enforces per-file and total input bounds.
Requests hosted image generation with OpenAI Codex credentials and returns the generated image with optional saved path metadata.
Registers both the openai-image command and model-callable openai_image tool.
Obtains OpenAI Codex credentials from Pi's model registry first and falls back to the agent auth file.
Refreshes subscription usage only for eligible OpenAI models and starts a timer at the configured interval.
Starts usage refresh on session activation and repeats it at the configured interval until the session stops.
Registers pet help, list, wake, tuck, and select behavior under one pets command.
